test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What according to the author is the highest good that one can do?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author emphasizes that spiritual help is the most substantial and far-reaching form of assistance because the need for it is greater.
 
• The text states that "helping man spiritually is the best help that can be extended to him."
 
• A spiritually strong person can be powerful in every aspect, and without spiritual strength, even physical needs cannot be well satisfied.
 
• Thus, extending spiritual help is considered the highest good according to the author.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1) Extending spiritual help to others**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2) Doing intellectual good to people:** While intellectual help is highly valued, it is considered secondary to spiritual help.
 
• **3) Monitory help:** The text does not mention monetary help as the highest form of assistance.
 
• **4) Helping others physically:** Although physical help is acknowledged as good, it is not deemed the highest form of help by the author.
